final: WITH member_major AS (SELECT m.link_to_major, maj.college, COUNT(*) as group_count FROM member m INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id GROUP BY m.link_to_major, maj.college), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) as sum_count FROM member_major), shares AS (SELECT mm.link_to_major, mm.college, mm.group_count, CAST(mm.group_count AS FLOAT) / ts.sum_count as share FROM member_major mm CROSS JOIN total_sum ts WHERE ts.sum_count IS NOT NULL), college_avg AS (SELECT college, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares GROUP BY college) SELECT s.link_to_major, s.college, s.group_count, s.share, s.share - ca.avg_share as diff FROM shares s INNER JOIN college_avg ca ON s.college = ca.college WHERE s.share > ca.avg_share ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
